profile.name: Hamilton倾斜模块
profile.description: 这是一种用于实验室自动化平台的机械倾斜模块，可按设定角度或位置倾斜样品载具，以辅助液体排空、沉降、分离或处理过程中的姿态控制。根据配置不同，模块还可带有加热、编码器、传感器输入、开集电极输出以及废液泵等功能。
profile.description_en: A mechanical tilting module for laboratory automation platforms that tilts sample carriers to defined angles or positions to support liquid draining, settling, separation, or controlled sample handling. Depending on configuration, the module may also include heating, an encoder, sensor inputs, open-collector outputs, and a waste pump.
